chunks.head: for the best
chunks.note: 常说 it's all for the best = 表面不好、其实是好事一桩。

literal.note_cn: 非'为了'的目的义,此处表'朝好的方向'

chunks.ex_en: Don't be sad—maybe it's all for the best.
chunks.ex_cn: 别难过——也许这一切都是好事。

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.note: meet with sth = 偶然遇到某事物(也可指遭遇困难)。
chunks.ex_en: On the trip we met with many kind people.
chunks.ex_cn: 旅途中我们遇到了很多好心人。

chunks.head: at last
chunks.note: at last = 经过漫长等待后终于。
chunks.ex_en: After hours of waiting, the bus came at last.
chunks.ex_cn: 等了几个小时,公交车终于来了。

chunks.head: be obliged to
chunks.note: be obliged to do sth = 出于必要或责任而不得不做。

literal.note_cn: 非'感激'义,此处'被迫、有责任'

chunks.ex_en: We were obliged to leave early because of the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 因为下雨,我们不得不提早离开。

chunks.head: take hold of
chunks.note: take hold of sth = 用手抓紧某物。
chunks.ex_en: She took hold of the rope and climbed up.

chunks.head: be acquainted with
chunks.note: be acquainted with sb/sth = 对某人或某物已经熟悉。
chunks.ex_en: I am not well acquainted with this city yet.
chunks.ex_cn: 我对这座城市还不太熟悉。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 很多。
chunks.ex_en: He spent a great deal of money on books.

chunks.head: get through
chunks.note: get through sth = 挺过或做完一件难事。
chunks.ex_en: With his help I got through all the homework.
chunks.ex_cn: 在他帮助下我做完了所有作业。

chunks.head: in the first place
chunks.note: 开头列举时'首先';也可指'本来、一开始'。本章为'首先'义。
chunks.ex_en: In the first place, we need to check the map.

chunks.head: in short
chunks.note: in short = 用一句话概括前面的内容。
chunks.ex_en: In short, the plan did not work.

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在等待某事发生的期间。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
chunks.ex_cn: 饭正在做;这期间我们摆好桌子吧。

chunks.head: do without
chunks.note: do without (sth) = 缺了某物也照样过。
chunks.ex_en: There was no sugar, so we did without.
chunks.ex_cn: 没有糖,我们就将就着没放。

chunks.head: bear with
chunks.note: bear with sb/sth = 有耐心地忍受;常说 bear with me。
chunks.ex_en: Please bear with me while I fix this.
chunks.ex_cn: 我修一下,请你耐心等一会儿。

chunks.head: wear out
chunks.note: wear out = 因反复使用而损坏或耗尽。
chunks.ex_en: These cheap shoes wear out very fast.
chunks.ex_cn: 这种便宜鞋很快就穿坏了。
